caption: The drawing depicts a large, cylindrical ceramic crock with a slightly flared rim and two small, rounded handles on either side at the top. The crock is primarily a light brown color with varying earthy tones, showing the natural gradient and texture of the clay. On the front, there is a blue decorative motif featuring a standing human figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a long dress or coat, with one arm extended and the other resting down, alongside a staff or walking stick. The figure is positioned under a blue arched design with stylized plants or vines on both sides, also drawn in blue. Above the decoration, the number “6” appears inscribed within a small circle, and a horizontal blue band encircles the crock near the top. The crock sits on a pale, almost white background. The overall composition centers the crock, capturing its three-dimensional shape and painted details.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
